privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.summary: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you shop at Anadolu Feneri Glass Art Center.
privacyPolicy.content:
Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what information we collect when you visit our website, create an account, or place an order, and how we use it.

We may collect contact details (name, email, phone, delivery address), order history, and technical data such as IP address and browser type to operate the store, process payments, and improve our services.

We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Payment processing may be handled by certified payment providers under their own privacy terms.

You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us. We retain data only as long as required for legal, accounting, or operational purposes.

For questions about this policy, please use our contact page.

termsOfUse.title: Terms of Use
termsOfUse.summary: Rules for using our website and placing orders.
termsOfUse.content:
By accessing and using this website, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

Product descriptions, images, and prices are provided for information. We reserve the right to correct errors and update listings without prior notice.

Orders are confirmed after successful payment or approval of the selected payment method. We may refuse or cancel orders in cases of stock unavailability, pricing errors, or suspected fraud.

Handmade glass items may show natural variations; such characteristics are not considered defects.

These terms are governed by applicable laws in Türkiye. Disputes should first be addressed through our customer service channels.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.summary: How we use cookies and similar technologies on our website.
cookiePolicy.content:
We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your language preference, maintain your shopping cart, and understand how visitors use our site.

Essential cookies are required for the store to function. Analytics cookies help us improve performance and are used only with your consent where required by law.

You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may limit some features such as checkout or language selection.

If you have questions about our cookie practices, please contact us.
